purpose: Provide local evidence for the canonical agent to evaluate whether planning workflows should require more concrete production contracts before runtime begins.

forbidden_without_human_approval: promoting project-specific decisions as global rules
scope_policy.proportionality: Apply strongly to aaa_game and vertical_slice projects; adapt or skip for exercise, technical_demo and consulting contexts.

curation_candidates.problem: Initial planning docs can look complete while still missing implementation-critical contracts for track data, collision, HUD, animation, tuning, assets, build, boss, flow and references.
curation_candidates.proposed_change: Add a proportional pre-runtime checklist for AAA/action projects requiring executable contracts before coding SECTOR_01 or equivalent first playable.
validation_evidence: validate_resources remains blocked only by expected material artifacts
risks: Could overburden small exercises or lab demos if applied without project_context gating.
Could become paperwork if not tied to runtime seed and validation reports.
curation_candidates.recommended_human_review: Review whether the checklist should become a planning gate for aaa_game only, with explicit exemptions for technical_demo and exercise.

curation_candidates.problem: Font, logo, menu and credits were easy to under-specify despite being required for a complete first impression.
curation_candidates.proposed_canonical_target: visual-excellence-standards front-end or project planning checklist
curation_candidates.proposed_change: Require brand_identity_manifest, glyph/text profile, menu contract and credits contract for game projects with title/menu.
risks: Credits content may be intentionally deferred before team roles are known.
Logo contract should not force final art before source art stage.
curation_candidates.recommended_human_review: Promote as a documented planning expectation, not as a visual delivery gate until assets exist.

curation_candidates.problem: A request for Makefile/build spec can conflict with the workspace rule that build logic stays in tools/sgdk_wrapper.
curation_candidates.proposed_change: Require new projects to create a build_system_contract declaring wrapper entry, minimum runtime seed files and why no custom local Makefile is canonical.
validation_evidence: Wrapper build path documented without local build logic
risks: Generated Makefile artifacts from wrapper must not be confused with source of truth.
Projects imported from outside may need migration path instead of immediate strictness.
curation_candidates.recommended_human_review: Review as a hygiene/policy clarification for all SGDK game projects.

curation_candidates.problem: Text-only planning left visual production under-guided; local mockups help, but must not be mistaken for final art or evidence.
curation_candidates.proposed_change: Allow local mockup SVG/PNG references in data/source_art with hash manifest and explicit mockup_reference_only status.
validation_evidence: Mockups explicitly marked not final art and not emulator evidence
risks: Mockups may bias final art too much if treated as approved style.
SVG references still require Mega Drive pixel reinterpretation and VDP budget.
curation_candidates.recommended_human_review: Review whether this should become a recommended planning artifact for AAA projects before pixel production.

curation_candidates.problem: A game project can have complete technical specs and still risk becoming generic if the first playable is not shaped by visible antagonist pressure, meaningful resource risk, sector-specific mechanics, signature setpieces, reactive audio and replay/mastery hooks.
curation_candidates.proposed_change: Add a proportional creative cohesion checkpoint for aaa_game projects before runtime seed: define the player fantasy, threat visibility, systemic risk, per-section mechanical identity, at least one signature moment, audio-as-feedback and replay motivation.
validation_evidence: Creative gates mapped into QA plan
Learning ledger records promotion_candidate without canonical mutation
risks: Could become subjective paperwork if not tied to concrete runtime fixtures.
Should be proportional: mandatory for aaa_game, optional for exercise or pure technical_demo.
Must not block runtime seed forever when placeholders can prove behavior honestly.
curation_candidates.recommended_human_review: Review whether this becomes a pre-runtime creative gate for game projects, with explicit exemptions for labs and exercises.

not_ready_for_promotion_reasons: No BlastEm evidence exists for Revive.
Patterns have been applied to one project only.
next_canonical_review_steps: Human reviewer reads this handoff and doc/agent_learning/planning_mode_curation_candidate.md.
Compare candidates against existing workflows to avoid duplicate rules.
If accepted, edit canonical .agent workflow/skill in a separate curated change with tests.
Update workspace memory after any canonical promotion.
